messages:
Ana (partnerships): Quick sync — are we all green to flip the marketplace live on Thursday 05:00 UTC? Need press embargo window, partner onboarding status, and final asset owners. @Chris, @Devon please chime in.

Chris (marketing): Press embargo confirmed for Thu 04:00 UTC; release notes go live at 05:00. Draft blog ready, waiting on legal headline signoff. :thumbsup:

Devon (solutions): SI onboarding: two partners (CloudScale, Integrum) still on staging. Integrum needs the OAuth redirect fix deployed. ETA today EOD.

Leslie (legal): I reviewed the draft headline and the partner quotes. Sent comments in the doc, short changes only. Can sign off by 15:00 UTC if applied.

Tom (eng): OAuth redirect fix is merged to staging, rollout to prod scheduled at 02:00 UTC Thu as part of staging cutover. I'll post the deploy plan in #release-war-room.

Sana (product): Landing page copy updated for partner logos and case blurb. Need final logo SVGs from partners by 18:00 UTC today.

Ana (partnerships): @Devon can you confirm Integrum's test pass after the 02:00 UTC deploy? Also we need analytics tags in the launch CTA.

Devon (solutions): Yep will run smoke tests at 02:30 UTC and ping here with results. For analytics: add `utm_source=marketplace&utm_campaign=partner-launch` to partner CTA; Chris can confirm.

Chris (marketing): Confirmed. Also add `utm_term=integrum` per partner. I'll hand off the press release to comms at 03:00 UTC.

Leslie (legal): Also flag: Integrum's quote needs the 'no endorsement' language per agreement. Devon/partners pls update.

Ana (partnerships): Noted. Who owns the embargo enforcement if queries from press come early?

Chris (marketing): I'll field inbound press until 04:30 UTC then handover to comms team. Add my mobile: +1-555-0102 for urgent media.

Tom (eng): Quick note — staging cutover runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/marketplace-cutover still needs a run-through checklist item for cache invalidation.

Ana (partnerships): Adding to checklist: cache invalidation, oauth redirect, logo assets, analytics tags, legal quote clause, partner training doc link. @sre-bot can you create a reminder at 01:30 UTC Thu for cutover ops?

sre-bot: Reminder created for 2890124400 (Thu 01:30 UTC) — /remind @eng-oncall run marketplace cutover checklist :white_check_mark:

Devon (solutions): Integrum updated logo received, staging tests pass after merged fix. Posting logs: ```curl -I https://staging.marketplace.redwood/partners/integrum | head``` results 200 OK.

Chris (marketing): Blog ready pending Lesie's final line. I'll push to CMS at 03:30 UTC and schedule social posts.

Leslie (legal): Signed off on final quote. Small wording tweak applied in doc, link: https://docs.redwood/legal/quotes/integrum.

Ana (partnerships): Great — final call: any blockers before we go into production deploy @everyone?

Tom (eng): Nothing critical. Monitoring dashboards (prod latency, errors, auth) will be live and triaged.

Devon (solutions): No blockers from SI onboarding side.

Chris (marketing): No blockers from press ops.

Ana (partnerships): OK excellent. I'll send final runbook and partner notification at 20:00 UTC. :rocket: Thanks all.
